description.narrative: (I) UPGRADING AND REHABILITATION OF APPROXIMATELY 900 KM OF RURAL ROADS IN 5 PRIORITY AGRICULTURAL AREAS; (II) MAINTENANCE; (III) ENVIRONMENTAL AND INDIAN COMMUNITY PROTECTION; (IV)INSTITUTIONAL STRENGTHENING OF THE RURAL ROAD UNIT AND THE ENVIRONMENTAL UNIT OF THE MINISTRY OF PUBLIC WORKS AND COMMUNICATIONS; (V) PREPARATION OF STUDIES FOR THE EVENTUAL SECOND STAGE. THE PROJECT WOULD BENEFIT LOW-INCOME FARMERS.
